facts.fact: Loi n°2018-027, adopted by the Senate on 27 November 2018, provides in article 10 that each civil status centre also keeps a digital database of its acts, fully digitised, accessible and centralised at the national civil status centre, alongside the two paper copies of each register that article 8 requires; this is what the law prescribes, not a statement that any office does it.
facts.system: Système Informatisé de l'Etat Civil Malagasy

facts.fact: Loi n°2018-027, adopted on 27 November 2018, makes the digital database of article 10 cover the acts of the registers listed in article 8: births and recognitions, deaths, marriages, simple adoptions and rejections, and transcribed court decisions; a legal provision, not a statement of practice.
facts.system: Système Informatisé de l'Etat Civil Malagasy

facts.fact: Loi n°2018-027, adopted on 27 November 2018, creates in article 7 a national civil status centre at central level under the ministry in charge of the Interior, and a civil status centre at the office of each commune and each diplomatic or consular post, with the mayor and deputies as civil status officers (article 16).
facts.system: Système Informatisé de l'Etat Civil Malagasy
